description.value: Best Buy Liquor Store is part of the Riverside Inn complex on the Cowichan River in Lake Cowichan, and claims the largest selection of beer, wine, ciders, coolers, and spirits in town alongside a full wall of grab-and-go chilled product. The store also stocks tobacco, mix drinks, snacks, and bagged ice, making it a practical resupply stop for self-catering touring cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley. It shares a riverside property with a boutique hotel and a breakfast-and-lunch cafe.

address.value: 56 North Shore Road, Lake Cowichan, BC V0R 2G0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Best Buy Liquor Store at 56 North Shore Road, Lake Cowichan, operating as part of the Riverside Inn complex (hotel, River Cafe, and liquor store) on the Cowichan River. The about-us subpage describes the store's large selection of beer, wine, spirits, grab-and-go chilled products, snacks, and bagged ice, but no page mentions bike parking, water refill, or washroom access for liquor store customers. The hotel subpage lists free WiFi and free parking as room-inclusive amenities, not as general visitor amenities, so those cannot be attributed to the liquor store.
